## Description and Rationale

I’m a recent MSc graduate from Imperial College London with a background in engineering and software development, and a strong interest in aviation and emerging technologies. Outside of engineering, I’m a private pilot and have also completed a seaplane rating, giving me a practical perspective on aviation alongside my technical background.

I joined the PRC Challenge for the opportunity to tackle an ambitious real-world problem, explore new ideas and develop a solution from the ground up.
